name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source expense splitting app for groups and friends, with balances, settle-ups, multi-currency expenses, receipt uploads and recurring expenses on PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: SplitPro has no password login: sign-in uses emailed magic links. Replace the placeholder EMAIL_SERVER_HOST and set EMAIL_SERVER_PORT, EMAIL_SERVER_USER, EMAIL_SERVER_PASSWORD and FROM_EMAIL for a working SMTP server, then redeploy. Google, Authentik, Keycloak or a generic OIDC provider can be added with the variables from the configuration docs.
Anyone who can reach the instance can sign up by email. Set DISABLE_EMAIL_SIGNUP to true after creating your accounts to close registration.
